description: Classification of all 492 SDUF checklist items by distance-measurement applicability. Covers all 13 SDUF guide files.

categories.horizontal: Requires plan-view distance measurement - tool CAN measure
categories.vertical-or-mixed: Requires vertical/3D clearance - tool CANNOT fully measure (yet)

subClassifications.distance-only: Distance measurement alone can resolve the verdict (compare measured value to threshold)
subClassifications.distance-plus: Distance measurement needed but verdict also requires additional information (see additionalRequirements)

additionalRequirementTypes.roadway-type-identification: Roadway type (Core Transit Corridor, Urban, Suburban, ICR) must be identified to determine applicable standards
additionalRequirementTypes.site-depth-measurement: Site depth must be measured to determine if shallow lot exceptions apply
additionalRequirementTypes.vmu-verification: Vertical Mixed Use status must be verified for applicable standards
additionalRequirementTypes.entrance-orientation-verification: Building entrance orientation must be verified on plans
additionalRequirementTypes.active-edge-verification: Active Edge designation must be verified on regulating plan maps
additionalRequirementTypes.landscape-buffer-verification: Landscape buffer compliance per LDC 25-2-1006 must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.landscape-element-verification: Landscape buffer element types must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.tree-spacing-verification: Tree spacing along sidewalk must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.species-verification: Tree species must be verified as utility-compatible
additionalRequirementTypes.root-barrier-specification: Root barrier details must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.shading-verification: Shading compliance (50% canopy or glazing/amenities) must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.use-type-verification: Ground floor use type must be verified as commercial
additionalRequirementTypes.architectural-element-verification: Architectural elements must be verified for facade articulation compliance
additionalRequirementTypes.pedestrian-access-verification: Direct pedestrian and bicycle access from street to entrance must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.street-orientation-verification: Street compass orientation must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.building-frontage-verification: Whether building frontage is provided along ICR must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.unit-count-verification: Residential unit count with street orientation must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.slope-verification: Adjacent slope gradient must be verified
additionalRequirementTypes.adjacency-verification: Adjacent property zoning must be verified
